headlines.title: 发改委：下半年物价有望保持平稳运行
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委政策研究室主任、新闻发言人蒋毅在新闻发布会上表示，今年上半年，我国物价总水平呈现持续回升态势。本轮物价回升，对企业的利润增加、财政收入增长、居民就业和增收产生积极推动作用，也有效促进了国民经济循环畅通。展望下半年，随着人工智能等新兴产业的加速发展，产能产量调控进一步加强，市场竞争秩序逐步优化，服务消费需求持续释放，将对物价持续回升形成良好支撑。同时，夏粮产量再创新高，肉蛋产能基础稳固，果蔬生产保持平稳，重要民生商品总体供给充裕。总的来看，下半年物价有望保持平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: NDRC: Prices expected to remain stable in H2
headlines.summary_en: Jiang Yi, Director of the Policy Research Office and Spokesperson of the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), said at a press conference that in the first half of this year, China's overall price levels showed a sustained recovery trend. The recent price recovery has positively driven corporate profit increases, fiscal revenue growth, resident employment and income gains, and has effectively promoted the smooth circulation of the national economy. Looking ahead to the second half of the year, with the accelerated development of emerging industries such as artificial intelligence, further strengthening of production capacity and output controls, gradual optimization of market competition order, and continued release of service consumption demand, there will be solid support for sustained price recovery. Meanwhile, summer grain output has hit a new record, meat and egg production capacity remains stable, fruit and vegetable production stays steady, and the overall supply of important livelihood goods is ample. Overall, prices are expected to maintain stable operation in the second half of the year.

headlines.title: 日本央行以8-1的投票结果维持利率不变，将视情况加息
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月31日讯，日本央行周五将政策利率维持在1%，符合预期。上个月该行已将基准利率上调至1995年以来的最高水平。日本央行审议委员高田创持异议支持加息25个基点，高田创认为形势已进入新阶段，日本央行需要采取灵活方式，以应对物价上行风险以及海外金融环境变化。日本央行表示，将继续根据经济和价格发展以及金融状况提高利率，基础通胀已接近2%，金融环境保持宽松，经济活动面临的重大下行风险和价格面临的重大上行风险均有所降低。在最新经济预测中，日本央行下调了2026财年的核心CPI预期，从2.8%降至2.5%，上调2026财年GDP增速预期，从0.5%上调至0.

headlines.title_en: Bank of Japan holds rates steady in 8-1 vote, will raise rates as appropriate
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, July 31 - The Bank of Japan kept its policy rate at 1% on Friday, in line with expectations. Last month, the bank had raised its benchmark rate to the highest level since 1995. Board member Takata created a dissent, supporting a 25-basis-point rate hike, arguing that conditions have entered a new phase and the BOJ needs to take a flexible approach to address upside risks to prices and changes in overseas financial conditions. The BOJ stated it will continue to raise rates based on economic and price developments and financial conditions, with underlying inflation nearing 2%, financial conditions remaining accommodative, and both significant downside risks to economic activity and upside risks to prices having diminished. In its latest economic projections, the BOJ lowered its core CPI forecast for fiscal 2026 from 2.8% to 2.5% and raised its GDP growth forecast for fiscal 2026 from 0.5% to 0.

headlines.title_en: NDRC: AI-Related Sectors Maintain Over 30% High Growth
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission held its July press conference. The NDRC spokesperson stated that in the first half of the year, China's pace of independent innovation in artificial intelligence accelerated, achieving rapid breakthroughs across multiple links of the entire industry chain. Jiang Yi, Director of the Policy Research Office and Spokesperson, highlighted: First, the computing power foundation has been solidified, with the first fully domestic 100,000-card AI supercluster officially put into operation; by the end of June, the national intelligent computing power scale reached 2.8 times that of the same period last year. Second, model capabilities have leaped forward, with domestic companies such as DeepSeek and Moonshot AI successively releasing multiple trillion-parameter open-source large models; the global total downloads of domestic large models exceeded 10 billion times, and domestic models are accelerating adaptation with domestic computing chips. Third, factor flows are active, with over 120,000 high-quality datasets built, and a virtuous cycle of mutual promotion among computing power, models, and data is rapidly forming. headlines.title: 发改委：将实施更加积极有为的宏观政策，增强经济发展和物价回升内生动力
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委政策研究室主任、新闻发言人蒋毅在新闻发布会上表示，下一步，国家发展改革委将会同有关部门实施更加积极有为的宏观政策，着力稳就业、稳企业、稳市场、稳预期，增强经济发展和物价回升内生动力。同时，密切关注重要民生商品、能源等重点品种的市场价格波动情况，持续做好保供稳价工作，保障市场供应总体平稳，价格平稳运行，切实兜牢民生底线。

headlines.title_en: NDRC: Will Implement More Proactive and Effective Macro Policies to Strengthen Internal Drivers for Economic Growth and Price Recovery
headlines.summary_en: Jiang Yi, Director of the Policy Research Office and Spokesperson of the National Development and Reform Commission, said at a press conference that next, the NDRC will work with relevant departments to implement more proactive and effective macroeconomic policies, focusing on stabilizing employment, stabilizing enterprises, stabilizing markets, and stabilizing expectations, to enhance the endogenous momentum of economic development and price recovery. At the same time, it will closely monitor market price fluctuations of important livelihood goods and key energy varieties, continue to ensure supply and price stability, guarantee overall stable market supply and stable price operation, and effectively secure the bottom line of people's livelihoods.
